title: A table of knotoids in $S^3$ up to seven crossings
summary: We present a complete classification of spherical knotoids with up to six crossings and conjecture that our classification up to seven crossings is complete. Our work extends the tradition of knot tabulation to the setting of knotoids introduced by Turaev. We describe the methods used to enumerate diagrams, simplify them, and distinguish equivalence classes using a collection of invariants including the Kauffman bracket, the Arrow polynomial, the Affine index polynomial, the Mock Alexander polynomial, and the Yamada polynomial of the closure.
